description:
Leonard Wilson Keenan 

Our Business is you.

4 Bedroom, 3 Bathroom Detached Family Home 

Richard Todd and LWK are delighted to present 12 The Crescent St Catherines to the Rush Co Dublin property market.

A beautifully presented and meticulously updated detached four-bedroom family home, ideally positioned on a quiet residential road overlooking a green area within this mature and highly sought-after development in Rush, Co. Dublin.

From the moment you arrive, the attractive red-brick façade, cobble-block driveway and carefully maintained exterior create an excellent first impression. The property has been thoughtfully upgraded and exceptionally well maintained by its current owners and offers spacious, versatile accommodation throughout, together with a host of modern and energy-efficient features including solar panels, triple-glazed windows and an EV charger.

On entering the property, you are welcomed by a bright and inviting hallway, complete with a convenient guest WC located beneath the stairs. Moving through the home, the accommodation opens into a spacious open-plan kitchen and dining area, designed with modern family living in mind. The kitchen is fitted with an abundance of base and eye-level storage, a breakfast counter, water filtration system and a separate pantry, while enjoying pleasant views over the rear garden.

The dining area provides an excellent space for both everyday family life and entertaining, with direct access to the beautifully landscaped, low-maintenance rear garden. From the dining area, the accommodation flows into a large and comfortable living room overlooking the front of the property. This welcoming space features an attractive fireplace with a wood-burning stove, creating a warm and inviting focal point.

Upstairs, there are four well-proportioned bedrooms. The principal bedroom has been recently renovated and features a contemporary en-suite bathroom, newly fitted solid-wood built-in wardrobes, additional storage and bespoke window seating. The remaining three bedrooms have also been thoughtfully designed to maximise space and storage. A newly renovated family bathroom completes the accommodation on this level.

From the landing, a spacious staircase leads to the converted attic storage space, currently used as a home office and second living area. This bright and versatile space benefits from two Velux windows and extensive storage within the eaves. There is also a separate closet with plumbing in place for a potential bathroom, offering excellent flexibility for a growing family and a variety of future uses, subject to any necessary planning and building requirements.

The property further benefits from a combi boiler and two water tanks. To the rear, there is a watertight lean-to, currently providing a highly practical utility and storage area. The cobble-block driveway provides off-street parking and includes an EV charger, while the addition of solar panels and triple-glazed windows further enhances the home's modern and energy-efficient appeal.

The landscaped rear garden provides a private, low-maintenance outdoor space, ideal for relaxing, entertaining and family enjoyment. Its thoughtful design makes it a wonderful extension of the living accommodation and a practical space for modern family life.

No. 12 The Crescent enjoys an excellent location beside a green area on a quiet residential road, within a mature and established development. Rush is a popular coastal town offering an excellent range of amenities, including local shops, cafés, restaurants, supermarkets, sporting facilities and recreational amenities.

The area is particularly well suited to families, with a choice of primary and secondary schools available in and around Rush. Rush Main Street is easily accessible and offers a wide range of everyday amenities, while the town's beautiful coastline and beaches provide excellent opportunities for walking, swimming and outdoor recreation.

The neighbouring seaside town of Skerries is also within easy reach and offers an excellent selection of restaurants, cafés, boutiques, beaches, harbour walks and leisure facilities, making this an ideal location for those seeking the perfect balance between coastal living and convenient access to local amenities.

The property is also well served by public transport, with local bus routes providing connections to Dublin City, Dublin Airport, Skerries, Balbriggan and surrounding areas. Rush & Lusk train station further enhances the area's appeal for commuters, offering convenient rail connections to Dublin City and beyond.

This is a superb opportunity to acquire a spacious, turnkey detached family home that has been lovingly upgraded and maintained by its current owners. With four bedrooms, three bathrooms, a versatile converted attic space currently used as an office and second living area, extensive storage, a landscaped low-maintenance garden, solar panels, triple-glazed windows, EV charging and a highly desirable location beside a green area, No. 12 The Crescent is sure to appeal to a wide range of purchasers.

A truly impressive family home offering space, comfort, versatility and modern convenience in one of Rush's most attractive and convenient residential locations.

Early viewing is strongly advised to fully appreciate all that this exceptional home has to offer.
